title: OpenCMO platform profiles
description: What Writer may write for each platform (docs/architecture/writer.md §7): read by Writer's prompt, the code checks, the cards and SQL's platform_profile(). apps/web/lib/cmo/platforms.check.ts validates platforms.json against the same rules in check:contracts; packages/engine/opencmo/platforms.py reads the same file.

id.description: Stored in content_items.platform and cmo_draft_outcomes.platform (20 characters at most).

platform.description: The account it goes out on (lib/screens/common.ts PLATFORMS).

kind.description: post: text that goes out on its own; caption: the words under a video; youtube: a long video's title and description.

limit.description: Characters of the text (the description for youtube), with headroom under the platform's own limit.

title.description: Characters of the title; only the youtube kind has one.

visibleBeforeMore.description: Characters shown before the platform's "more" on a phone; null when the whole text shows.

hashtags.description: Most hashtags allowed; 0 for every post (decided 2026-10-26: hashtags only on videos).

tone.description: One line for the writer, read after the cached prompt prefix.
